evals.prompt: Generate a seeded dungeon map (seed 7) for my tabletop game into the folder out/dng in the current directory, and check it is sound.

evals.baseline: 2026-11-16 claude -p sonnet, no plugin: wrote its own generate_dungeon.py and out/dng without recipe.json; mpw.py check fails. FAIL (skill needed).

evals.prompt: Make a 20x16 square-grid battle map (seed 3) and export it as a Universal VTT file at out/battle.dd2vtt.
expectations: out/battle.dd2vtt exists, is JSON with resolution.pixels_per_grid and line_of_sight

a recipe.json written by mpw.py gen battle (kind battle, seed 3, w 20, h 16) sits anywhere in the run folder, and mpw.py check passes on its folder; a hand-written script producing only a .dd2vtt fails

evidence.run: python -c "import json,glob,os,subprocess,sys; r=[f for f in glob.glob('**/recipe.json',recursive=True) if (lambda j:j.get('kind')=='battle' and j.get('seed')==3 and j['params'].get('w')==20 and j['params'].get('h')==16)(json.load(open(f)))]; ok=os.path.exists('out/battle.dd2vtt') and r and subprocess.call([sys.executable,'scripts/mpw.py','check',os.path.dirname(r[0])])==0; sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)"

evals.baseline: 2026-11-16 claude -p sonnet, no plugin: hand-written script wrote a valid dd2vtt (70 px, 24 LOS segments), so file evidence alone is redundant; evidence sharpened to a recipe the export came from.
